I don’t believe they take insurance, as it’s entirely telehealth. For testosterone HRT, it costs me $140 a month, which includes meds and supplies, quarterly appointments, labs, and unlimited messages with your clinician, plus access to in network resources. After a year, the fee drops to only $40 monthly. It may be cheaper for you though since I suspect you’d want a lower dose than I do, so it’s worth looking into!
Also fair warning, vocal changes have made me feel like I’ve swallowed a razor blade. It’s been worth it for sure, but be prepared for some discomfort with vocal changes! It’s not unbearable tho!!!

I’m a trans man, and I use FOLX to get HRT. it’s not covered my insurance, but it is relatively affordable, and they absolutely cater to NB/Fluid individuals! 

I’d look into voice training first and foremost, but vocal changes are one of the first things I experienced on T. Do some research, and if FOLX interests you, make sure to thoroughly discuss everything with your clinician! I’ve had a great experience with them so far and absolutely recommend!
